items.heading: Australian Meat Pie
details: Key ingredients: pastry, ground beef, gravy, onion
Simmer ground beef with onion and stock into a thick gravy filling.
Line small pie tins with pastry and fill with the beef mixture.
Top with a pastry lid, sealing and venting the top.
Bake until the pastry is golden and flaky.

items.heading: Pavlova
details: Key ingredients: egg whites, sugar, cornstarch, whipped cream, fruit
Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks, gradually adding sugar until glossy.
Fold in a little cornstarch and vinegar for a marshmallowy center.
Shape into a disc and bake low and slow until crisp outside, soft inside.
Top the cooled meringue with whipped cream and fresh fruit.
